runner.title: Run requests
runner.nothingToRunHint: Save requests to the collection, or pick another folder or tag filter, then run them here.
runner.truncated: Only the start of a long body is kept in a run. Send the request on its own to see all of it.
runner.idle: Requests run in sidebar order with their scripts, extract rules and checks, using the environment chosen for their collection. A data file runs everything once per row. With parallel above 1, requests are sent together and do not see each other's extracted variables.

runner.dataOverridesMore_other: Each row sets {{columns}} and {{count}} more, in place of any request, folder or environment variable with the same name.
